activation_values.name: activation_values
activation_values.value: "event_activations"."revision" >= 0 AND "event_activations"."identity_check" IN ('pending', 'passed', 'failed') AND "event_activations"."payout_check" IN ('pending', 'passed', 'failed') AND ("event_activations"."successful_payment_attempt_id" IS NULL) = ("event_activations"."activated_at" IS NULL) AND ("event_activations"."terms_version" IS NULL) = ("event_activations"."terms_accepted_at" IS NULL)

item_totals.name: item_totals
item_totals.value: "order_items"."quantity" > 0 AND "order_items"."unit_price_minor" >= 0 AND "order_items"."subtotal_minor" = "order_items"."quantity" * "order_items"."unit_price_minor" AND "order_items"."discount_minor" BETWEEN 0 AND "order_items"."subtotal_minor" AND "order_items"."total_minor" = "order_items"."subtotal_minor" - "order_items"."discount_minor"

order_amounts.name: order_amounts
order_amounts.value: "orders"."currency" = 'KZT' AND "orders"."subtotal_minor" >= 0 AND "orders"."discount_minor" BETWEEN 0 AND "orders"."subtotal_minor" AND "orders"."total_minor" = "orders"."subtotal_minor" - "orders"."discount_minor" AND "orders"."processing_fee_minor" BETWEEN 0 AND "orders"."total_minor"

support_change_values.name: support_change_values
support_change_values.value: "support_case_changes"."sequence" >= 1 AND "support_case_changes"."kind" IN ('created', 'message', 'assignment', 'status') AND json_valid("support_case_changes"."before_json") = 1 AND json_valid("support_case_changes"."after_json") = 1 AND json_type("support_case_changes"."before_json") = 'object' AND json_type("support_case_changes"."after_json") = 'object' AND ("support_case_changes"."kind" IN ('created', 'message')) = ("support_case_changes"."message_id" IS NOT NULL)

support_case_domain.name: support_case_domain
support_case_domain.value: "support_cases"."audience" IN ('attendee', 'organizer_platform') AND "support_cases"."status" IN ('open', 'in_progress', 'waiting_for_customer', 'resolved') AND "support_cases"."category" IN ('ticket_delivery', 'payment', 'refund', 'seating', 'event_information', 'check_in', 'account', 'activation', 'technical', 'dispute', 'compensation') AND length(trim("support_cases"."subject")) BETWEEN 1 AND 160 AND "support_cases"."revision" >= 1 AND "support_cases"."last_sequence" = "support_cases"."revision" AND "support_cases"."updated_at" >= "support_cases"."created_at" AND ("support_cases"."status" = 'resolved') = ("support_cases"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("support_cases"."resolved_at" IS NULL OR "support_cases"."resolved_at" BETWEEN "support_cases"."created_at" AND "support_cases"."updated_at")

support_case_context.name: support_case_context
support_case_context.value: ("support_cases"."ticket_id" IS NULL OR "support_cases"."order_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("support_cases"."order_id" IS NULL OR "support_cases"."event_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("support_cases"."audience" <> 'attendee' OR "support_cases"."event_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("support_cases"."category" NOT IN ('refund', 'dispute', 'compensation') OR "support_cases"."order_id" IS NOT NULL)

support_message_values.name: support_message_values
support_message_values.value: "support_messages"."sequence" >= 1 AND length(trim("support_messages"."body")) BETWEEN 1 AND 8000 AND length("support_messages"."author_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 256
